title: Navigation and dialogue truth
hypothesis: Making navigate_to and the interaction loop warning say only what the game supports in this incumbent's arms (no planned route through a coordinate trigger whose condition matches now, and a refusal that names that trigger; the blocker named; where a partial walk or the press cap stopped; the reopened-message sentence only when a message reopened) removes the false leads seen in the 2026-10-16 cook audit (sh02 T260-307: 45 repeats of the Birch push-back from routes across the PreventExit triggers at (6,15-18) and (7,13); 3f21 T121-149: about 28 turns aimed at (10,0) behind the NeedPokemon triggers), so more runs reach STARTER_CHOSEN, in fewer turns.
notes: Correctness fix, intended ON in both arms of bundle-v-control (experiments/fixed/bundle-v-control.json is owned by another thread and not edited here). Registered 2026-10-16 on branch claude/navigation-truth (operator the operator approved the cook-audit fixes at 5:34 AM EDT). Activation: the first map with coordinate triggers and talk targets the model walks to after the truck (the NeedPokemon triggers at Littleroot (10,1)/(11,1)). The trigger part needs coordinate-script-conditions-v1, which is on in this incumbent. Provisional source.commit is branch commit 4a582a5f (it contains both switches and these entries); repinned to the merge SHA with `just experiment-pin` when it lands. The talk-offer part (no offer for an object with no script), the stand-tile and nearest-tile trigger checks and counter talk only to someone with a script act inside the refusal reasons of navigation-refusal-reasons-v1 and counter-talk-v1, both off in this incumbent, so this A/B does not measure them; they are covered by tests and act in bundle-v-control. The switch's dialogue parts (whole pages, kept speakers, narration without a speaker) act only with dialogue-auto-advance-v1, which is off in this incumbent, so this A/B measures the navigation and loop-guard parts; the dialogue parts are covered by tests and act in bundle-v-control, where auto-advance is on.
